status_note: A bug in the documentation, or in `round`: the docs and the kernel disagree. Reproduces on Polars 2.1.0 (2.675 rounds to 2.68 in both `half_` modes); the docstring was unchanged on main on 2026-11-04. No upstream issue found.
title: Docs: `round`'s `half_` modes do not round to the nearest value (2.675 gives 2.68)
summary: The documentation of `Expr.round` (https://docs.pola.rs/api/python/stable/reference/expressions/api/polars.Expr.round.html, py-polars/src/polars/expr/expr.py#L2001-L2025 at py-2.1.0) says strategies starting with `half_` "round all values to the *nearest* rounded value, only using the strategy to break ties when a value falls exactly between two rounded values".

`round(d)` rounds `x * 10^d`, itself rounded, and divides back (crates/polars-ops/src/series/ops/round.rs#L100-L136), so a double just below a decimal tie can round up. The double 2.675 is 2.67499999999999982236…, nearer 2.67, and Polars gives 2.68 in both `half_` modes; 1835.665 (1835.66499999999996362…) gives 1835.67 with `half_away_from_zero`. Polars's own `test_round` (py-polars/tests/unit/lazyframe/test_lazyframe.py#L564) expects 1835.67 for the default mode, gets 1835.66, and passes only on its `rel_tol` of 1e-5.
repro:
import polars as pl
pl.Series([2.675, 1835.665]).round(2).to_list()                               # [2.68, 1835.66]
pl.Series([2.675, 1835.665]).round(2, mode="half_away_from_zero").to_list()  # [2.68, 1835.67]
# 2.675 is 2.67499999999999982236…, 1835.665 is 1835.66499999999996362…:
# neither is a tie, the nearest values are 2.67 and 1835.66 (Python's round gives both).
handling: Nothing to work around: sverify follows the engine's behaviour, which the facts record. The fix is in Polars's documentation. Suggested fix: say that a decimal text's ties may round either way (as Python's `round` docs warn), or round the exact value in the kernel.
found_by: the Polars characterization reverse pass (2026-11-04): the docstrings and user guide at py-2.1.0 checked against each open fact

checked.note: Probe on both engines (POLARS_IDEAL_MORSEL_SIZE=64): `round(2)` of [2.675, 1835.665, 0.285, 1.005] is [2.68, 1835.66, 0.28, 1.0], with `half_away_from_zero` [2.68, 1835.67, 0.28, 1.0]. Main at 35a2cb73: the wording is at expr.py#L2016-L2017. Duplicate search for "round nearest docs 2.675", "round half_to_even 2.675" and "round decimals incorrect": no matching issue.
triage: repro run on 2.1.0; pola-rs/polars searched
